rationale: Recurring noun (5x on this page) paired consistently with ⲕⲣⲁϥ 'guile' and ⲟ̄ⲱϣⲛⲧ 'disturbance' as a state of negligence allowing cosmic disorder. Functions in both the watchman context ('lest they commit torpor or guile') and the cosmogonic context ('she wrought a great torpor in the sea'). Likely Manichaean technical term for νωθρία / oblivion-sleep cast by matter.

Verbal noun from ⲧⲱⲟⲩⲛ 'rise, stand up.' Designates a cosmic dimension or order from which the five noetic ones are chosen by the Ambassador. Preserves vertical-directional semantics consistent with Manichaean light-ascent vocabulary.
Lycopolitan reflex of ⲡⲉⲧⲉⲕⲟ 'the prison'; phrase 'the prison of the bound ones' (ⲛⲉⲧⲙⲏⲣ) is unambiguous. Distinct from ⲧⲉⲕⲟ 'destruction' attested elsewhere on the page.

Greek φερέκατοχος, technical Manichaean cosmological figure stationed in the Great Mind in the upper encampment over the prison of the bound ones. Acts as warden tasked with the destruction of the entire darkness of Death. Greek title retained.

Greek ἐγρήγοροι, the Watchers of the Enochic tradition adapted to Manichaean cosmology — the angelic guardians of the third firmament who descended to earth, revealed the irons (metallurgy) and the heavenly mysteries to humanity, and brought torpor and destruction upon the earth.
Orthographic variant of ⲡⲗⲓⲗⲟⲩ 'the Youth' (already in glossary). Same Christological epithet of Jesus, here as 'icon of the beautiful word of the Proclamation and the Hearing.'
Verbal noun from ⲟⲩⲱϣ-stem cognate with ⲟⲩⲱϣⲣ̄ 'spread/scatter, disturb.' Paired in line 26-27 with 'torpor' and 'guile' as the three traits arising in the Watchers' encampment.

Plural noun for irons/metals revealed by the Watchers from the cosmos to humanity, in direct parallel to the Enochic motif of fallen angels teaching metallurgy. Etymology likely related to ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲡⲉ/ⲃⲉⲛⲓⲡⲉ 'iron' (cf. accumulated ⲃⲁⲛⲓⲡⲉ).
Lexeme of uncertain identity opening a new section. Possibly feminine of ⲡⲁⲗⲁⲙⲁⲥ 'the contriver,' or a Greek-derived term, or a personal/place name. Flagged for parallels in subsequent kephalaia.
